Square 1:1 full-color educational comic puzzle illustration in a clean modern middle-school textbook style. A school treasure hunt takes place in a locked cabinet room. Show a friendly student detective kneeling beside a wooden treasure chest with three separate locks. Make exactly THREE identical red shield badges clearly visible on a clue board beside the chest. Include small visual hints such as grouped objects and a trail of colored keys, but do not include written clues. Use a four-panel composition in one square image: discovering the chest, counting the three red badges, examining the locks, and getting excited at the chest. Keep the three red badges unmistakable and easy to count. No text, no letters, no numbers, no readable symbols, no watermark.

Square 1:1 full-color educational comic puzzle illustration in a clean modern middle-school science textbook style. A student detective investigates a school garden at dusk. Clearly show one leafy plant with several nibbled leaves, one green caterpillar on a leaf, one sparrow nearby with one fallen feather, and one non-threatening grass snake beside a visible shed snake skin. Arrange these as separate visual clues in a coherent garden scene, with the detective studying the evidence through a magnifying glass. Make each organism easy to identify and keep the scene friendly rather than frightening. Do not draw arrows or written clues. No text, no letters, no numbers, no readable symbols, no watermark.

Square 1:1 four-panel full-color educational comic puzzle illustration in a clean modern middle-school English textbook style. Set the story in a school hallway. Keep two characters consistent across all panels: Mia wears a yellow hoodie and carries a purple backpack; Leo wears a blue jacket and carries a green backpack. In the key second panel, clearly show Mia checking an open locker while Leo looks under a desk at the same time; a blue dictionary is partly hidden beneath the desk. Include a simple analog wall clock whose hands point to five past eight, but use no numerals. The other panels show the students discovering the missing dictionary, following clues, and finding it. Make the simultaneous actions unmistakable. No text, no letters, no readable numbers, no watermark.
